title: .kit/settings.yml
description: The repository's choices, read by the kit and never written by it. Delivered by kit, not edited by hand; docs/modules.md says what each key means. An editor validates the file against it through a modeline: # yaml-language-server: $schema=settings.schema.json

forge.description: The provider the loop's verbs use. Detected from origin's host when absent.

gate.description: What kit gate runs. A justfile ci recipe, a Makefile ci target, or a package.json ci script is detected when absent.

require_signing.description: true makes kit issue refuse a desk without a signing key.

^[a-z_]+$.description: The value a module's template takes for this key, written @key@ in the template.
